Landbridge.//PublicMcpUrl: The plane's public MCP endpoint a worker dials; landbridged wraps it plus the minted worker token into the harness's --mcp-config at dispatch (§13). Override via LANDBRIDGE_PUBLIC_MCP_URL. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:5050. This is also the OAuth 2.1 canonical resource id / issuer (§5): set it to the real public https URL in production.

Classifier.//Url: Optional permission classifier (POST /classify). Unset or unreachable is Ask, never fail-open. Aspire sets http://127.0.0.1:5310.

Landbridge.//InfrastructureRequeueLimit: §9 check 7: how many times one task may be requeued for infrastructure reasons (undelivered dispatch, aliveness loss, no progress, process exit, machine reboot) before the control plane abandons it as canceled instead of redispatching it forever. Verification retries are counted separately and are what drive `rejected` (§6, two counters). Unset defaults to 5; a value <= 0 turns the cap off and restores the pre-cap behaviour of unlimited requeues. The cap is fixed on each task at creation, so a change applies to tasks created after it.

Operator.//PassphraseHash: Identity PBKDF2 hash of the operator passphrase that gates /oauth/authorize (§5). Store the HASH, never the plaintext. When unset (or a leftover SHA-256 hex) the authorize endpoint is fail-closed (503).

Oauth.//AllowInsecureClientMetadata: DEV/TEST ONLY. When true, the CIMD fetcher accepts http and private/loopback client_id hosts, disabling the SSRF address fence. Never enable in production. Default false.
